title: FizzBuzz
prompt: Implement fizz_buzz(n) that returns a string for a positive integer n: "FizzBuzz" if n is divisible by both 3 and 5, "Fizz" if divisible by 3 only, "Buzz" if divisible by 5 only, otherwise the decimal representation of n. Also expose a range helper that returns the space-joined fizz_buzz values for 1..15 inclusive.
acceptance: range 1..15 starts with "1 2 Fizz 4 Buzz" and contains "FizzBuzz" for 15
